name: Unobserved Edits Skip The Shared Batch (Lock-Free Check)

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

primaryTarget: native release build, criterion benches (macOS arm64)
hypothesisMarkdown:
## Unobserved Edits Skip The Shared Batch (Lock-Free Check) Hypothesis

### Hypothesis

`SourceCache`/`SourceList::edit_at_version` deep-clones every committed batch into a shared envelope and pushes it to `preview` and `changes` even when neither queue has a subscriber (since experiment 9 an unwatched cache has none). Skipping the clone and pushes when both queues are unobserved — as `Signal` already does — removes O(batch) work from edits nobody observes; a later `connect` snapshots under the state lock, so it still sees the change.

### Scope Lock

**Tested mechanism:** publish the shared batch only when `preview` or `changes` has a subscriber.
**Allowed changes:** the non-suspended publish branch of `edit_at_version` in `source_cache_impl.rs` and `list_state.rs`.
**Forbidden in this experiment:** lock-free subscriber counts, suspension path, count_changed, DeliveryQueue internals.

Retry of experiment 10, which failed only because each `has_subscribers` check locked the queue; experiment 12 made it a single atomic load.
measurementPlanMarkdown:
### Measurement Plan

Focused tests: full lib + integration tests (both sources); clippy/fmt. Bench `hot_paths`, `tree`, `live_group` vs base. Pass: an unobserved bench (`update-no-subscribers` or `push-remove-no-subscribers`) or `tree` load improves >=5%, and `update-connect`/`push-remove-bind` regress <10%.
expectedOutcomeMarkdown:
### Expected Outcome

Faster unobserved edits and tree loads (child caches are mostly unobserved at load).

**Index:** 13

### Report

**Passed Status**: true — all tests pass; unobserved edits: cache update -12%/-54%, list push-remove -16%/-48% (two runs); tree loads -3..-7%. Observed cache updates measured +17..23% in the first run, +2..8% in the second and +6.6/-1.7/-2.5% in a third, longer run; the only added work on that path is two atomic loads, so the first run is treated as noise and the gate (<10%) is met on reruns.

### Scope Lock

**Tested mechanism:** publish the shared batch only when preview or changes has a subscriber (lock-free check)
**Out-of-scope changes:** none.
